timeline.1992: Beginning of critical infrastructure, high-scale data processing and BPO.
timeline.2004: Global expansion: infrastructure in major events across Europe, Americas, Africa and Asia.
timeline.2012: Pioneer in specialized privacy and advanced digital security services.
timeline.2015: Launch of software and processes division, focusing on high performance digital engineering.
timeline.2016: Incubation of NESS Technology Healthcare (which would later become IONIC Health).
timeline.2017: Incubation of Trustness as a strategic business unit for GRC.
timeline.2022: Incubation of forense.io as a leader in digital investigation.
timeline.2024: Established as a modular platform for reliable and secure digital transformation.
timeline.2026: Launch of AI and Agents operation, consolidating ness. as a leader in intelligent knowledge orchestration.

hero.subtitle: specialization in digital forensics following ISO 27037/27042 — judicial expertise, corporate investigation, and incident response.

why.title: why it matters
why.desc: Digital evidence is volatile and can be destroyed in minutes. Digital forensics is essential for judicial investigations, incident response, and compliance. forense.io conducts expertise with ISO 27037/27042 methodology, preserving the chain of custody and producing defensible reports in court.

ransomware.title: ransomware
ransomware.subtitle: Determine entry point and scope of compromise
ransomware.desc: Memory forensics (RAM), disks (bit-by-bit cloning), and logs to map attacker TTPs and incident extent.

datalen.title: data leak
datalen.subtitle: Track how sensitive data left the company
datalen.desc: Analysis of DB access, network logs, emails, and devices to identify exfiltration vector and authorship.

judicial.title: judicial process
judicial.subtitle: Expertise of seized device (notebook, smartphone)
judicial.desc: Accredited judicial expert performs technical examination with structured report and oral defense in hearing.

corp.title: corporate investigation
corp.subtitle: Internal fraud or intellectual property violation
corp.desc: Endpoint forensics (emails, WhatsApp, Drive) with respect to LGPD/GDPR and preserved chain of custody.

resources.title: core resources
resources.desc: complete forensic expertise following international standards

disk.title: Disk Analysis
disk.desc: Bit-by-bit cloning, deleted file recovery, filesystem analysis (NTFS, ext4, APFS).

ram.title: Memory Forensics (RAM)
ram.desc: Analysis of processes, network connections, malware in memory, and volatile credentials.

mobile.title: Mobile Forensics
mobile.desc: Logical/physical extraction of smartphones (iOS/Android), app analysis, WhatsApp, Telegram.

network.title: Network Forensics
network.desc: PCAP analysis, firewall logs, IDS/IPS, HTTP/HTTPS session reconstruction.

timeline.title: Timeline Analysis
timeline.desc: Chronological reconstruction of events (file system, registry, logs) to understand the attack sequence.

custodian.title: Chain of Custody
custodian.desc: Complete documentation of evidence preservation, collection, transport, and analysis (ISO 27037).

report.title: Expert Reports
report.desc: Structured technical reports with ISO 27042 methodology, reproducible and defensible in court.

testimony.title: Expert Testimony
testimony.desc: Oral defense of report in judicial hearings with language accessible to legal professionals.

counter.title: Counterproof and Re-examination
counter.desc: Critical analysis of third-party reports and identification of methodological flaws.

preservation.title: Evidence Preservation
preservation.desc: On-site or remote collection with certified tools and cryptographic hash for integrity.
